Definition: to pour out (literally or figuratively), i.e. empty
BiblicalUsage: 1) to make empty, empty out; 1a) (Hiphil); 1a1) to empty, keep empty or hungry; 1a2) to pour out or down; 1a3) to empty out; 1b) (Hophal) to be emptied out
